page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. Powered by a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor, it features 128 dedicated vCPUs and 256 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, providing 2.0 GB of memory per core.

The instance provides high network throughput with a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps to handle substantial data transfer across distributed environments. It contains no local disk storage and no GPU hardware accelerators, necessitating network-attached block storage for persistent data needs. The high count of 128 dedicated vCPUs optimizes parallel execution, though workloads with high per-thread memory requirements may face memory constraints.

Offering compute density across 128 core allocations, ecs.c7.32xlarge delivers cost-efficient resource utilization for processing tasks that do not require specialized GPU acceleration. The balance of high core count and 64 Gbps networking makes it suitable for distributed batch processing, software compilation, continuous integration pipelines, ETL jobs, and web serving.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.32xlarge is a compute-optimized x86_64 server instance running on KVM hypervisors. Driven by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.7 GHz, the configuration offers 128 dedicated vCPUs paired with 256 GB of total memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio (2.0 GB per core). It is equipped with a 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth for high-throughput network operations. The instance lacks integrated GPUs and local disk storage, meaning persistent storage must be attached via network volumes. Its high core count and strong networking baseline optimize resource efficiency for distributed parallel execution. The instance fits high-concurrency web serving, compute-intensive batch jobs, continuous integration builds, and large-scale ETL workloads.
